_derivation.note: IAS = Integral Ad Science. The reporting product is 'IAS Signal'; the data API is the IAS Reporting API (RESTful, GET-only, synchronous) at https://api.integralplatform.com/reportingservice/api/. official_fields.json is a CURATED authority snapshot: the official reference (reporting.integralplatform.com/help/rs) is a login-gated SPA that is not statically fetchable, so the field set was assembled from IAS's own documented measurement families (viewability, invalid traffic / IVT, brand safety & suitability, risk categories, quality impressions, attention, video, carbon) cross-corroborated across three independent connector references. The camelCase source_field tokens follow the Funnel connector's field naming, which is the closest public proxy for the raw IAS API columns.
_derivation.authority_caveat: Because the exact wire field names, the date-range query-parameter names, and the JSON response envelope are NOT confirmable from a statically fetchable official page, this catalog is the DECLARED contract only. It is proven against the real API by the live ratification probe (scripts/ratify_connector.py), which stays deferred until a real IAS Signal account connects. public_catalog.verification stays 'blocked' until then. See ROLLOUT_NOTES.md.
_derivation.exposure: exposure_policy is 'manifest': the six additive count metrics + three structural dimensions declared in manifest.source_capabilities.fields are 'exposed' (extracted by the exact_bundle daily profiles); every other cataloged field is 'planned'. Ratio/rate and index metrics are deliberately left planned -- they are recomputed downstream from their additive numerator/denominator counts rather than summed.

probe.structural_note: The IAS Reporting API selects metrics + dimensions as query parameters on a GET /reportingservice/api/teams/{teamId}/platform/{platform}/campaigns/{campaignIds}/report over a date window. The probe would request up to 25 metric fields per call over a 1-day window against the selected team+campaign, bisecting a rejected batch to isolate the offending field. request_style/batch_size are declared now; the live probe is deferred until an IAS account connects (see ROLLOUT_NOTES.md).
